sc: They could be dropped by any monster in the area between Rimmington and the Lumber Yard and Lumbridge farm (north of the sheep herd in Lumbridge right around the pond).
They could also be obtained in a special "around the world" drop party held by a Jagex Moderator.
In addition, they could be obtained from the Falador Party Room.
It is created by poisoning a adamant spear with poison karambwan paste, and can be given to Tamayu so that he can attempt to defeat the Shaikahan.
After completing Tai Bwo Wannai Trio, kp poisoned spears can be bought from Tamayu's Spear Stall.

s: The Islands That Once Were Turtles
tx:
Ancestral energies can be used to charge one of the tortle portals on the Islands That Once Were Turtles, requiring 50 energies. Once charged, the portal grants players access to a positive and negative wisp colony on the Islands That Once Were Turtles. This portal provides access to the Power of the Ancestors divine energy shop and additional mushroom clusters. On the third and last island, 50 more ancestral energies can be used to charge the last tortle portal, providing one-way access back to Waiko. 
Originally the tortle portal by the player's ship also required 50 ancestral energies to charge, but this was later changed.
sc: Ancestral energy can also be created by harvesting positive energy and negative energy, both of which require level 90 Divination.
50 ancestral energies are a reward for completing the Tuai Leit's Own miniquest, which requires level 90 Divination.

Antipoison++ flask.x: The is a potion flask containing six doses of potion. It is created by using potions on a potion flask. Only the six-dose flask is tradeable on the Grand Exchange, but lower-dose versions can still be traded directly with other players.

tx: The Apex hide boots + 1 is created by first making a unfinished apex hide draft at a pattern table, then working on it at a drafting table for 144 progress. It then turns into an unfinished apex hide boots, which needs 336 progress at a tailor's dummy to complete.
sc: It is made by upgrading an apex hide boots with 1 apex leather via the tailoring process, requiring level 100 Crafting.
It can be crafted with a spider leg to make the noxious scythe, a melee weapon, with level 90 Crafting.
An Araxyte egg is an item dropped by Araxxi that can be inspected to unlock the miniature-boss pets Barry and Mallory.
The egg can only be received by those who already have all six Araxyte pets.
Additionally, it can be made by dyeing an undyed version or upgrading a non-elite version.

The augmented Saradomin godsword is a tier 75 melee two-handed weapon created by using an augmentor on a Saradomin godsword or by using an augmented Saradomin godsword (passive) on the Saradomin Altar.
It can be made by using an augmentor on a Zaros godsword (shadow), or by using shadow dye on an augmented Zaros godsword.
The Aurora 2h Sword is two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.

Barbarian Maul.x: Barbarian Maul is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that is part of the Barbarian outfit.

sc: The barrier (class 3) from the Stealing Creation minigame is made by using a class 3 of sacred clay on a creation kiln.
If a player happens to die they will spawn to the nearest built barrier or in the teams base.
A total of eleven is given to the player by Lupe.
A beach party ticket is an item that was given by Reyna during the Summer Beach Party (2015), and appeared in the player's backpack upon login during the 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025 beach event.
The berserker ring is one of the Fremennik rings and is dropped by the Dagannoth Rex in the Waterbirth Island Dungeon.
It can be obtained as a Treasure Trail reward or purchased from either another player or from the Grand Exchange.
It cannot be made using the Crafting skill.
It can be obtained by killing blissful shadows, pickpocketing from Amlodd workers, or as a possible reward from light creatures on the Prifddinas Agility Course or the Motherlode Maw.
It can also be received as a possible reward from Meg.
The Boots of Hearts are a feet slot cosmetic override that could be unlocked by purchasing the King and Queen of Hearts Pack.
It is made by using sacred clay class 4 on a creation kiln, which requires level 60 Fletching.

u: Custom-fit trimmed spiked masterwork melee boots
sc: Custom-fit trimmed masterwork equipment can be obtained by speaking to Elof in the Artisans' Workshop while wearing the full trimmed masterwork equipment set.
They can be made at a forge and anvil using 12 necronium bars and necronium platelegs + 2, requiring 2,880 progress to complete, granting a total of 6,000 Smithing experience.
It can be made with Crafting from 1 molten glass or obtained as a drop from a cave bug.
Candle lanterns can also be obtained by looting an eclectic impling that has been caught.
It's made by adding dwellberries and sacred oil to an empty canopic jar, in either order.
Castle wars tickets (silver) are awarded after completing the Castle Wars minigame.
However, no tickets are awarded if you did not spend at least 10 minutes in the game.
It was given to the player by Denulth so that Dunstan's son could join the Imperial Guard.
Cherry Blossom Fan is a main hand ranged weapon cosmetic override that is unlocked by claiming a cherry blossom fan token.
A cherry blossom wand token is an item that can be claimed to unlock Cherry Blossom Wand, a main-hand weapon cosmetic override, destroying the item in the process.

The token was first made available on 8 February 2024 from Gifts from the Heart, a Treasure Hunter promotion, but it can also be purchased by both normal and Ironman Mode players from the Grand Exchange.

Chic scarf (orange).x: The orange version of the chic scarf is available from the Marketplace for 250 oddments. The scarf was originally red only, and then on 28 November 2016 it had 10 colours added and can be freely recoloured between them via a right-click option.

sc: Chopped tomato is made by using a bowl on a tomato with a knife in your inventory.
Clue scroll (easy) is a simple clue obtained from easy sealed clue scrolls.

q: Turning the jewel blue will morph the Balmung into a Cobalt Balmung.
sc: The Cobalt Balmung is a reward for completing the miniquest, Koschei's Troubles.
The code key is found in Zemouregal's study in New Varrock palace during Dimension of Disaster: Curse of Arrav, which requires a vial of orange mist to access.

Combat Mastery aura (Master).x: Combat Mastery aura (Master) is a cosmetic override aura unlocked by completing the Combat Mastery - Master achievement.

sc: A Constitution XP lamp is awarded after defeating the Leprechaun Champion in the Champion's Challenge arena.

w: Big event mystery box (2017 Valentine's Day event)
Event mystery box (2017 Valentine's Day event)
sc: A crown of misery is a cosmetic head item that could be obtained by redeeming 800 Valentine love notes.
Valentine love notes are no longer obtainable, but any left over could still be converted into a crown of misery before their removal on 14 March 2014.

They are obtained by upgrading a pair of tier 60 deathwarden gloves with 1 Hermodic plate, 2 pieces of ensouled cloth, 2 spools of ensouled thread, and 20 bone runes after the completion of Kili's Knowledge V (power).

Eastern kimono (green).x: The green eastern kimono is part of the eastern outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

Elf-style skirt (blue).x: The blue elf-style skirt is part of the elven outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: It is made by dyeing an elite sirenic hauberk with a shadow dye.
It may also be created by upgrading a new sirenic hauberk (shadow).
An empowered curved artefact is an item made from a prepared curved artefact during the fifth combat-related assignment given by a God Emissary leader.
It can bought from any Slayer master for 50,000 coins and can be placed on the tool belt.
After completion of Kennith's Concerns, super explosive shakers can be made, which deal 150 life points when a mogre comes out of the water.
The exquisite halberd is a two-handed, multi-tier weapon obtained from the Squeal of Fortune.
The flatfish & gissel potato is a unique food used in the Dungeoneering skill and can only be found in Daemonheim.
It is made by using a baked cave potato with cooked flatfish or a gissel mushroom.
Following of the Dungeoneering tool belt, this item can no longer be obtained as a physical object.

Golden warpriest of Zamorak gauntlets.x: The golden warpriest of Zamorak gauntlets is a hybrid glove armour that can be won from the Balthazar's Big Raffle (except the 2015 raffle) and is part of the golden warpriest of Zamorak armour set.

Golem of Justice Boots.x: Golem of Justice Boots is a feet slot cosmetic override that is part of the Golem of Justice set.

sc: The half-moon spectacles (blue) are a reward from a master clue scroll.
A Herblore XP lamp is a reward from the Heralds of Crimson quest.

Huge dawn lantern.x: Huge dawn lanterns can be obtained as part of the Celestial Lanterns promotion on Treasure Hunter. They give both direct experience and bonus experience in a skill of choice when released, destroying the lantern.

Infernal Kal-Zuk Cape.x: The Infernal Kal-Zuk Cape is a back slot cosmetic override that can be purchased from the Marketplace for 580 RuneCoins for free-to-play players and 522 RuneCoins for members.

sc: It, along with the regular Divination master skillcape, could be unlocked by accounts in the Fresh Start Worlds game mode that reached virtual level 120 Divination.

The cape can also still be unlocked by any account in the main game by consuming an Inverted Divination master skillcape token, though the inverted cape can only be equipped if the player also has virtual level 120 Divination.

Ironman (Hardcore, 5 Year armour).x: Hardcore Ironman (5 Year armour) is a cosmetic override outfit only available to hardcore ironmen. It is unlocked by talking to Mr Ex and is only available if the account is 5 or more years old.

sc: Kerapac's mask piece is an item dropped by Kerapac, the bound that can be used to unlock the boss pet Kerry.
It can be obtained through Vic's Store for 50 credits.
While it is seen on the reward scroll, it cannot actually be obtained by players.
Magic bean (leafy) was a type of magic bean which could be bought from the Farmers' Market for 1,000 beans alongside other magic beans.
The magical orb is a quest item given to the player during the quest The Hand in the Sand.
They are obtained from V's journal and assembled to created the map.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 mithril bars and a mithril off hand mace, requiring 640 progress to complete, granting a total of 240 Smithing experience.
Moonlight Enchanter hood is a head slot cosmetic override that is unlocked through the Academy of Skillers promotion from Treasure Hunter.
To obtain this item, players must partake in smithing a ceremonial sword after randomly being given plans when they finish smithing an item in the Artisans' Workshop.
Although only members can smith this sword and it is untradeable, the wield option and the stats are available in free-to-play.
It may be produced using the Smithing skill or obtained as a monster drop.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 4 orikalkum bars and an orikalkum pickaxe + 1, requiring 1,400 progress to complete, granting a total of 1,400 Smithing experience.
It is given to the player by Ezekial Lovecraft, the owner of the fishing store in Witchaven.
The pendant of Thievery is a pendant of skill that may be obtained as a prize from the Squeal of Fortune.
The permafrost knight off-hand mace is an off-hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 16 of The Knight Before Christmas while having access to premier rewards.
Platinum Virtus Armour is a cosmetic override set that can be unlocked by redeeming a Platinum Virtus Armour token.
Radiant Warden Outfit is a cosmetic override that can be purchased for 1,250 Underworld Emblems from the Hero Store.
It was made by upgrading a full slayer helmet for 100 Slayer points at any Slayer Master, although subsequent upgrades would only cost 10 Slayer points.

q: Ring of visibility (can be re-obtained from Rasolo for free)
tx:
• Accessing the Shadow Dungeon during and after Desert Treasure.
• Seeing the Mysterious ghosts for the miniquest Curse of the Empty Lord miniquest.
• Seeing General Khazard and his scouts as part of The General's Shadow miniquest.
• Seeing Hopespear and completing the Hopespear's Will miniquest.
• Seeing invisible portals to the Spirit realm.
• Seeing an invisible Heat globe pedestal in Ritual of the Mahjarrat.
• Seeing Saint Elspeth's ghost to obtain the Holy Cithara.
• Seeing the ghost penguin after Some Like It Cold.
• Using it on the Ring of stone to spawn TzHaar-Ga'al-Kot.
• Seeing, controlling and using the World Gate at Arandar.
• Seeing Soran, Emissary of Zaros on the back of Tuska during the third World Event.
• Seeing a ghost legionary after a shadow anchor is lit up in the Kharid-et Archaeology dig site
sc: The ring of visibility can be obtained from Rasolo the merchant after the player retrieves his cross for him during the quest Desert Treasure.
The ring of visibility cannot be made using the Crafting skill.
The royal dragonhide chaps are a piece of royal dragonhide armour, made by crafting two royal dragon leathers.
The royal dragonhide coif is a piece of royal dragonhide armour, made by crafting two pieces of royal dragon leather at level 65 Crafting, giving 188 experience.
Royal dragonhide coifs were originally a degradable reward obtained as a reward from the Fist of Guthix minigame.
The royal sceptre is obtained from looting kingly implings.

tx: The rune burial battleaxe requires 720 progress to finish.

sc: It is made by adjusting the three other schematics over the base schematics.

Sir Owen Greatsword.x: The Sir Owen Greatsword is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Sir Owen pack.

sc: To be eligible for any hypnowand piece drops, the player must have read the aged journal, found in the Warped Depths of the Daemonheim Dig Site.
Skull pieces are obtained as a drop from wallasalkis, found underneath Waterbirth Island.
The skull piece along with 1 dagannoth hide and 5,000 coins can be traded to Peer the Seer for a skeletal helm.
A Slayer XP lamp is awarded when defeating the Earth Warrior Champion.
Though rare, all Imcando metal pieces are found within the Warforge Dig Site and the material caches outside the dig site which require level 76 Archaeology to access.
A raw spider on stick is a raw food made from spider carcass and a skewer stick.

h: Egg Hunt (Treasure Hunter promotion)! Egg Hunt
sc: Springtime Boots (Natural) is a feet slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked through the Egg Hunt promotion from Treasure Hunter.
It is created by combining an elemental impetus, a mystic fire staff, and a fire talisman.
It is crafted from a starbloom robe bottom + 3 and starbloom cloth using the tailoring process, granting a total of 63,360 Crafting experience.
Striped vines are drops from tracking and catching hunting camouflaged jadinkos.
Alternatively, these can be used to ward off common jadinkos to manipulate the seeds given by the offering stone in the Jadinko Lair.
Sundown Stout is a drink that can be purchased from Last Leg Tavern in Heathervein.
Super defence potions are made by adding clean cadantine then white berries in a vial of water, giving 150 Herblore experience.
A teddy was one of the items found in the reward chests during the 2014 Halloween event.
Once the Teddy was hugged, it would vanish from your inventory and another one would have to be obtained from a chest in Death's house.
Timber fungus is a crafting material obtained at the Croesus Front with 88 Woodcutting.

Tribal skirt (black).x: The black tribal skirt is part of the tribal outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: A tyrannoleather torn bag is a drop from most monsters in Daemonheim.

sc: The red uncharted island map is a map that can very rarely be obtained while Deep Sea Fishing.
The ring Luck of the Dwarves has no effect and is not required to obtain the map.
Very smooth stone is an item found during the fifth skill-related assignment given by a God Emissary leader.
These can be found along with Smooth stones by using your emissary banner on any type of fishing spot.

r: Partial completion of Ritual of the Mahjarrat after finding the tune banite ore scroll
sc: Wallasalkibane arrowheads were made by smithing wallasalkibane bars on a Kethsian anvil, requiring level 80 Smithing, producing 75 arrowheads and giving 700 experience per bar.
Wallasalkibane arrows are now made by casting Tune Bane on bane arrows.

Werewolf Legs (override).x: The Werewolf Legs are a legs slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Werewolf outfit. They are the override equivalent of the Werewolf legs item.

Zamorak cloak (Castle Wars).x: The Zamorak cloak is an item used in the Castle Wars minigame. Players are given their teams' cloak when they enter any of the three God portals: Zamorak, Saradomin or Guthix.

sc: The Zamorak fruit is a type of Jadinko fruit that can be found in the Jadinko Lair, received through the offering stone or from Mutated jadinko drops.
The zephyrium warhammer is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.
The Zombie Spine Bow is a two-handed ranged weapon override obtained by prestiging the fleshy parchment during the Walk Like a Zombie promotion.
